description: Mutations of the real loop of lot L4: each patch, applied to a temporary worktree of the repository, is played by the runner and judged by the oracle of the unmodified tree. A rejected mutation must get the verdict, the assertion with its status (FAIL unless `assertion_status` says otherwise) and a reason holding the fragment below; when `stopped` is given, the campaign must also say that the run stopped, with that fragment. A known survivor is reported and does not fail the run until the finding it names is merged.

mutants.mutation: the store loses the payload its obligations still owe when the exchange is released
mutants.reason: names a payload the store does not hold

mutants.mutation: the dispatcher hands the core a certain rejection for lack of capacity where the store rejected for a fence
mutants.note: Known survivor: the oracle does not yet close the chain from the result the store produced to the result the core consumed (finding K1, lot L3). Once K1 is merged this entry becomes rejected, with its assertion and reason.

mutants.mutation: the core makes PUBREC Success eligible with the submission of the admission, before any commit is known
mutants.reason: eligible before the core knew of a commit

mutants.mutation: the core no longer matches the answers of its landmark resolutions, so an answer that arrives after more newer resolutions than it keeps recent is absorbed (finding F3)
mutants.reason: the footer does not declare the trace complete
mutants.stopped: step 19 (DriveUntil): nothing is eligible and the awaited event did not happen
mutants.note: Step 19 waits for the PUBREC that answers the late answer: the run stops there. An interrupted run is never a PASS; whether a wait that can no longer be met is a FAIL is lot L3's to decide.
